summary:
The trusted Home route may retain a verified committed export after retiring its source filesystem; old source device/inode/owner identity need not survive. Home is the trusted local owner, not a defense against compromised Home. Keep the original context, operation/key, journal and CAS; settle writers, copy exact selected cold bytes and commit the retained observation before removal. Read never grants cleanup. Only the first successful BeginCleanup reply supplies consumed permission; missing replies and expired windows retain the original hold. Finite cleanup-only recovery binds the same original and committed export to fresh resources, without renewed useful work or recopy. Image manifest/repository and configuration IDs need actual metadata joins.

The28October first-path decisions select standard managed Host controller/direct-QEMU services consuming independently established capacity. Prebirth grants bind operation/unit/source/input/policy; actual activation binds current manager generation and process identity. Relative job timeouts do not stop units or prove pre-manager transit expiry. Complete finite ownership, dependency/reference/generation custody, stop/drain and lost-effect handling remain implementation/qualification requirements. CPU limits, affinity width, physical allocation, memory ceilings and address-space limits are distinct. All concurrent roles, complement, backing, spool, retained archive and independent collector require actual fit. No documented mechanism or selected ceiling proves current native admission.

An explicit versioned bounded Guest path uses the real authenticated provider and a PID1-owned rootless payload service. It does not fabricate acceptance of the wider legacy Home/Root/staging role graph. Its one-file result uses the existing authenticated channel, actual payload/writer settlement and a preheld exclusive Host spool with bounded bytes/inodes. Fsync, close writers, restrict and cold-verify actual Host pins/content before the unchanged typed constructor/copy helper, durable Commit and first cleanup permission. Archive/journal stay outside all retiring devices. This expressly supersedes the earlier Host block-detach/read-only-mount requirement ONLY for the bounded profile; full BAR/image block export keeps that route. Partial/lost results remain Unknown without re-execution, blind recopy or permission regrant.

Full runner qualification keeps its actual14GiB-available/80GiB-free gates and separate BAR/image, reboot, two-machine, publication/adoption and recovery promises. An authenticated cloud base is not a prepared execution image. Hash-bound development replay reuses immutable inputs/artifacts with explicit versions and executed stages, never live reservations, PIDs, clocks or cleanup receipts. Native stream EOF, process/group/cgroup settlement and independent collection remain separate observations. Retained archive custody stays charged after VM cleanup. One complete fresh actual-entrypoint trace, precise remaining gaps and whole-candidate review determine readiness; source delivery and focused tests do not establish it. Live owning issues remain authoritative and this record grants no operation.
title: Trusted Home commits exports and supplies the dedicated qualification target
